title: arcsignal
tagline: AI-powered prediction markets with transparent signals, market consensus, and settlement evidence.
description: ArcSignal is an AI-powered prediction market platform where users can explore crypto and event-based markets, compare AI confidence against market consensus, and make more informed predictions. The project focuses on a proof-first experience: clear market rules, resolution sources, cutoff times, settlement status, transaction history, and transparent AI signal reasoning. Instead of only showing odds, ArcSignal gives users a structured intelligence layer around every market so they can understand why a prediction may be valuable, risky, or disputed.
how_its_made:
ArcSignal is built as a web application with a modern frontend for prediction market discovery, AI signal cards, market analytics, and user-facing settlement information. The frontend uses React/Next.js-style components, wallet-ready UX patterns, and a proof-first market interface. The AI layer is designed to compare agent confidence with market consensus and explain the reasoning behind predictions. The project also plans support for oracle-based resolution, settlement receipts, explorer links, and transparent market metadata so judges can clearly verify how each market moves from prediction to final outcome.

AI tools were used as development assistants for planning, UI copy, implementation guidance, and technical research, while the project direction, product decisions, integrations, and final submission are directed by the team.
auto_summary: ArcSignal is a web-based prediction market platform with USDC-denominated smart contracts, market indexing, and AI-generated signal analysis.
